# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure at Rosewood Street Bakery

**Report ID:** RSB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 14, 2024
**Date of Report:** March 21, 2024
**Prepared by:** Operations Review Team
**Classification:** Internal — Quality & Safety

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 11:20 p.m. on March 14, 2024, the walk-in cooler at Rosewood Street Bakery experienced a compressor failure during a period of high ambient load. The failure went undetected until staff arrived at 4:15 a.m. the following morning. By that time, interior cooler temperatures had risen from a normal operating range of 36–38°F to approximately 58°F. An estimated $2,400 in refrigerated inventory — including custards, cream-filled pastries, mousse cakes, and fresh dairy — was discarded as a precaution. No product reached customers, and no illnesses were reported.

The purpose of this report is to document the timeline, identify contributing factors, and recommend corrective actions. The review team emphasizes that this incident resulted from a combination of system, scheduling, and equipment factors — not from the actions or inactions
